name: astur-mobile-examples
description: Convenience commands for Astur example test suites and inspector sessions.

scripts.help: node -e "console.log(['Available example commands:', '  npm run doctor', '  npm run devices', '  npm run devices:android', '  npm run devices:ios', '  npm run test:android', '  npm run test:ios', '  npm run test:ios:real', '  npm run test:ios:simulator', '  npm run test:parallel', '  (append -- <spec> to any test:* command to run a single spec, e.g. npm run test:ios -- specs/login.test.ts, or npm run test:android -- native-locators.test.ts)', '  npm run codegen:android:emulator', '  npm run codegen:ios:simulator', '', 'Layout:', '  specs/           shared, platform-agnostic test files + fixtures + page objects', '  config/android/  Android Playwright configs', '  config/ios/      iOS Playwright configs', '  assets/          demo-app builds (../assets from here); *.zip are the checked-in artifacts, *.app are extracted on demand', '', 'Flutter demo app:', '  npm run test:android:flutter', '  npm run test:ios:flutter', '  npm run codegen:android:flutter', '  npm run codegen:ios:flutter', '  (Android Flutter needs a live Flutter source checkout to attach the Dart VM service -- ASTUR_FLUTTER_PROJECT defaults to ../../asturapp on the flutter branch; ASTUR_FLUTTER_PATH is optional if flutter is on PATH)', '  (iOS *.app bundles extract automatically from ../assets/*.zip inside the Playwright config, the same way the Android configs resolve their APK -- no manual unzip and no extra npm-script step; override with ASTUR_IOS_APP_PATH)', '  (iOS suites run fewer specs than Android: media-upload and webview are excluded on both iOS configs, drag-and-drop additionally on Flutter iOS -- see testIgnore in config/ios/*.ts for why)'].join('\n'))"
scripts.codegen:android:emulator: npm --prefix .. exec astur-mobile -- codegen --android --device emulator-5554 --app ../assets/astur.demo.android.apk --app-id com.astur.demo
scripts.codegen:android:flutter: ASTUR_FLUTTER_PROJECT=${ASTUR_FLUTTER_PROJECT:-../../asturapp} npm --prefix .. exec astur-mobile -- codegen --android --device emulator-5554 --app ../assets/astur.demo.android_flutter.apk --app-id com.astur.demo
scripts.codegen:ios:simulator: node scripts/ensure-ios-app.mjs ../assets/Astur.app ../assets/astur.demo.ios.simulator.zip && npm --prefix .. exec astur-mobile -- codegen --ios --simulator --app ../assets/Astur.app --app-id com.astur.demo
scripts.codegen:ios:flutter: node scripts/ensure-ios-app.mjs ../assets/Runner.app ../assets/astur.demo.ios.simulator_flutter.zip && npm --prefix .. exec astur-mobile -- codegen --ios --simulator --app ../assets/Runner.app --app-id com.astur.demo
